dict.string: Rings your wake-up alarm, even when the app is closed or the iPad is on silent.
Connects to your Garmin watch to read heart rate, steps, activities and sleep, instead of Garmin Connect.
Scans food barcodes and takes photos of meals and grocery receipts for your food journal.
Listens on the iPad for "Hey Jarvis" so you can control the hub by voice. Audio only leaves the iPad after the wake word.
